consequence.statement: Bump of the github/codeql-action CI dependency; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: CI dependency github/codeql-action bumped from 3.28.13 to 3.28.15; a build-pipeline change with no stated operator impact.

decision.reason: [ev-ddadc146dd66] is only a Dependabot bump of github/codeql-action from 3.28.13 to 3.28.15 in the "What's Changed" list. Nothing in it says that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is supported. The release document shows no operator-facing effect, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the evidence implies no impact rather than stating it outright, and the locator places the line under a "BREAKING CHANGES" heading even though the item itself describes no breakage.
